headline: One day of daylight and the pipeline went dark again - Saturday is a blank, so the only thing I can read cleanly is a 17 km/h gust that becomes 74 tomorrow.
body:
Yesterday is unjudged, not missed. training.json is still stamped **9 October 21:32**, now **34.5 hours** old, and 10 Oct 07:50, 21:30 and today's 07:50 all passed without a push - so Saturday has no activity file and no wellness row at all. Fifth drought, laptop not watch, every time. The last one opened seven dates and **five carried a real session**, so I'm claiming nothing about yesterday.

The wind I can read, and it says go now. **17 km/h gust, 2 km/h mean, 16 C - open water good until 11:00**, the calmest water in the whole file. Tomorrow gusts **74** and shuts bike, run and sea in every window.

So: **1,200-1,500 m at 2:20-2:35/100 m**, sight every six strokes, no sprint off the start. The gate (**hrv 65 then 59 against a 68.6 mean**, two days stale) costs you nothing - open-water Z2 *is* the easy version.

Last swim file of any kind: **12 September**. In the sea: **23 August**.

How's the ankle on rotation this morning?
